items: eBay hiring for US pickup and drop-off network. Job listings reported by Value Added Resource show eBay building a lower-cost PUDO network for its marketplace and Depop. CEO Jamie Iannone said a limited seller drop-off test in several large US metro areas is planned for Q4.

Lawmakers question USPS $19.5B borrowing request. Thirteen members of the Congressional Postal Service Caucus, led by Rep. Nikki Budzinski, wrote to Postmaster General David Steiner on Nov. 4. They asked how USPS would use a borrowing-limit increase from $15 billion to $34.5 billion, with replies requested by Nov. 13.

Ex-DSP driver files Amazon no-poach class action. A former Delivery Service Partner driver filed in New Jersey federal court against Amazon.com Inc., Amazon.com Services LLC and Amazon Logistics Inc. The plaintiff alleges a hidden no-poach practice keeps driver pay low for hundreds of thousands of U.S. drivers.
